finding: The main tests do not establish the expected weakening of the posting-to-growth relationship at higher ghost scores.
scoring: Same seven 3-point and four 1-point features, score>=3; received/declined offers zero; all eligible outcomes in denominator.
missingness: Only complete company-year classifications; missing financial expenses remain missing.
smoothing: Past-only firm prior with ten-review shrinkage; pooled rate available at the fiscal end for firms without earlier classified history. Pre-2016 classified history available for the earlier issuer footprint. Raw and full-history alternatives retained.
search_history: Primary and sensitivity comparisons follow earlier exploratory tests. Four-outcome and 40-interaction adjustments are supplied; they do not cover every prior research choice.

design_recorded_before_estimation.purpose: User-authorized completion of all remaining linked Loujaina review classifications, followed by Yen posting-by-ghost tests on the complete linked universe.
design_recorded_before_estimation.primary: Same feature weights, threshold and offer override. Past-information EB primary, raw share and full-history prior sensitivities. Actual fiscal-year assignment for every issuer. Posting and financial variables frozen to the prior audit.
design_recorded_before_estimation.labels: Existing Luna cache plus all 196361 new authorized unique narratives, with ten prior contradictory feature records revisited. Original noncontradictory labels remain untouched.
design_recorded_before_estimation.complete_cohorts: Every eligible review in a company fiscal year must be resolved; never form shares from just whichever no-offer reviews happen to be cached.
design_recorded_before_estimation.matching: Same direct corroborated RCID -> financial GVKEY as corrected posting primary. No parent-only or name-only mapping. Check review company IDs for conflicting RCIDs/financial issuers.
design_recorded_before_estimation.controls: Full Lourie change controls plus corrected book-to-market, SIC2/year effects, firm-clustered finite-sample errors. Core controls omit R&D/advertising only and are labelled. Posting ranks, winsorization, dates and financial outcomes remain exactly as in audited panel.
design_recorded_before_estimation.inference: Retain all four outcomes and all specifications; Holm correction across four outcomes within each spec/term family, plus across all interaction tests for transparency. No tuning by signs or p-values.
design_recorded_before_estimation.api_calls: Batch-only new classification; budget ledger retained in parent directory.
design_recorded_before_estimation.primary_coverage_amendment_before_any_es: Classification queue completed before fitting. Remove the preclassified-issuer restriction, retaining complete company fiscal cohorts throughout all linked issuers; no outcome-dependent selection of classified versus unclassified new firms.

baseline_finding: Within this same review-linked sample, more job advertisements predict growth in employment, operating spending and sales, surviving adjustment across the four outcomes.
